name: Logitech G815
notes: 65-byte report descriptor of the keyboard interface (interface 0) of a real Logitech G815, read with usbhid-dump from the device: https://github.com/zocker-160/keyboard-center/issues/8#issuecomment-921344466. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
